transactions.desc: The Twins optioned Anderson to Triple-A St. Paul on Sunday.
The Yankees recalled Jones from Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre on Sunday.
The Twins reinstated Sands (forearm) from the 15-day injured list Sunday.
The Giants recalled Whisenhunt from Triple-A Sacramento ahead of his scheduled start Sunday versus the Angels in San Francisco.
The Twins reinstated Prielipp (finger) from the 15-day injured list ahead of his scheduled start Sunday versus the Athletics at Target Field.
The Athletics recalled Serven from Triple-A Las Vegas on Sunday.
The Nationals recalled House from Triple-A Rochester on Sunday. He'll start at third base and bat fifth in the Nationals' series finale versus the Diamondbacks.
The Red Sox activated Suarez (groin/illness) from the 15-day injured list to start Sunday's game against the Blue Jays, Gabrielle Starr of the Boston Herald reports.
The Red Sox optioned Gamboa to Triple-A Worcester.
The Washington Nationals traded INF Curtis Mead to the Boston Red Sox.
The Boston Red Sox traded LHP Connelly Early to the Washington Nationals.
The Red Sox acquired Mead from the Nationals on Saturday in exchange for Connelly Early (elbow), Jeff Passan of ESPN.com reports.
Minnesota reinstated Raya (shoulder) from the injured list Saturday and optioned him to Triple-A St. Paul, Aaron Gleeman of AaronGleeman.com reports.
The Rangers recalled Smith from Triple-A Round Rock on Saturday.
The Astros recalled King from Triple-A Sugar Land on Saturday, Julia Morales of Space City Home Network reports.
The Mets recalled Wagaman from Triple-A Syracuse on Saturday.
The Guardians recalled Dion from Triple-A Columbus on Saturday.
The Phillies optioned Lazar to Triple-A Lehigh Valley on Saturday.
The Phillies recalled Backhus from Triple-A Lehigh Valley on Saturday.
The Phillies optioned McFarlane to Triple-A Lehigh Valley on Saturday.
The Phillies selected Keller's contract from Triple-A Lehigh Valley ahead of his scheduled appearance Saturday against the Yankees.
The Athletics optioned Muncy to Triple-A Las Vegas on Saturday.
The Athletics reinstated Kurtz (thumb) from the injured list Saturday.
The Rays optioned Roycroft to Triple-A Durham on Saturday.
The Rays reinstated Matz (ankle) from the injured list Saturday.
The Kansas City Royals traded OF Kameron Misner to the Philadelphia Phillies.
The Phillies designated Berroa for assignment Saturday.
Atlanta recalled Thomas from Triple-A Gwinnett on Saturday.
Atlanta designated Hernandez for assignment Saturday.
Triple-A St. Paul reinstated Culpepper (hand) from the 7-day injured list Friday.
